newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss upper house approves key parts of econ plan.
newsitem.headline: Swiss upper house approves key parts of econ plan.

text.p: The upper house of Switzerland's parliament approved key portions of the government's economic stimulus package on the first day of a special session called to deal with the moribund economy.
The lower house is set to vote on the measures tomorrow.
The upper house approved measures earmarking 154 million Swiss francs for road construction and 200 million francs for renovating public property. The session was continuing.

Berne says its plan to put up 561 million francs in matching funds could generate 2.4 billion in total infrastructure spending, add a third of a percentage point to gross domestic product in 1998 and 1999 and create 24,000 jobs.
